title: Florida House, District 42
what_it_does: Represents District 42 in the Florida House of Representatives; votes on state laws and the state budget.
decided_note: Open seat: Democratic Rep. Anna Eskamani is term-limited and running for Orlando mayor. Democrat Felipe Sousa Lazaballet and Republican Bonnie Jackson meet on Nov. 3, 2026.
verified_ballot_note: Ballotpedia's HD 42 page: 'Felipe Sousa Lazaballet (D) and Bonnie Jackson (R) are running in the general election for Florida House of Representatives District 42 on November 3, 2026' (https://ballotpedia.org/Florida_House_of_Representatives_District_42); Wikipedia's 2026 election page notes Eskamani is term-limited and running for Orlando mayor. Research limitation: every WebFetch (Ballotpedia, Wikipedia, Division of Elections, county SOEs, news sites) was blocked and the search budget was capped, so this roster comes only from search-result snippets and should be re-verified against the county Supervisor of Elections sample ballot.
